- Required items from Aurelia: a representative model spec (or model family), a staging endpoint or sample payloads, and a security contact to confirm networking/KMS needs.

Proposed slots (all PT):
- Mon Dec 13, 10:00–11:30 AM PT
- Tue Dec 14, 1:00–2:30 PM PT
- Wed Dec 15, 8:30–10:00 AM PT

Who we’ll bring:
- Logan Wright — Solutions Engineering (host)
- Soojin Lee — ML/Infra Engineer (deep-dive lead)
- Ben Carter — Platform Solutions (demo & ops runbook)

Suggested 60–90 minute agenda (attached draft):
1) 10 min — goals & success criteria (Aurelia + Redwood)
2) 25–40 min — architecture walkthrough + integration checkpoints
3) 15–25 min — live runthrough (sample request -> response, cache behavior)
4) 10–15 min — next steps & mutual action items

Attachments: redwood-tdx-agenda-v1.pdf (draft agenda), mutual-action-plan-aurelia.xlsx (MAP stub).

Can you confirm your preferred slot and the Aurelia attendees we should loop in (security/infra/ML)? If none of these work, let me know two times that do and I’ll lock it in.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning calendars.
